passages.passageText: The way that people work has changed significantly in recent years. Many companies now allow the staff to work from the comfort of the home. This shift started because of global health concerns, but it continues because of the benefits it offers. Employees save time because they do not have to commute to the office. They also feel more productive in a quiet environment. However, there are some challenges. Some workers feel isolated because they lack the social interaction of the office. They might miss the casual conversations with the colleagues. Furthermore, the boundary between the work life and the home life can become blurry. If a person works in the living room, they might find it difficult to stop thinking about the job after the shift ends. Managers also have to find new ways to monitor the progress of the team. In the future, a hybrid model that combines the office and the home might become the standard for most industries.

en.explanation: The passage states that employees save time because they do not have to commute.

en.explanation: The text notes that some workers feel isolated due to a lack of social interaction.

en.explanation: Blurry here refers to the lack of clear boundaries between professional and personal time.

passages.passageText: Urban gardening is a growing trend in many large cities around the world. Since many people live in apartments without a traditional backyard, they use balconies and rooftops to grow plants. These small green spaces provide fresh vegetables and help to reduce the stress of the city life. Community gardens are also popular. This is where a group of neighbors shares a piece of land to grow food together. It is an excellent way to meet people and build a sense of community. Furthermore, urban gardening is good for the environment. Plants help to clean the air and keep the city cool during the hot summer months. However, urban gardeners must be careful about the quality of the soil and the amount of water the plants receive. Growing food in a city requires patience and planning, but the rewards are significant for the health of the individual and the planet.

passages.passageText: Social media has transformed the way that individuals communicate and share information. While it allows people to stay connected with friends and family, it also has a significant impact on mental health. Many studies suggest that spending too much time on these platforms can lead to feelings of anxiety and low self-esteem. This often happens because users compare the life of themselves to the perfect images that others post. It is important to remember that most people only share the best moments of the day, not the struggles. Furthermore, the constant notifications can cause a person to feel overwhelmed. To maintain a healthy balance, some experts recommend a digital detox. This means taking a break from the phone for a few days to focus on the real world. By setting limits on the use of social media, people can protect the mental well-being while still enjoying the benefits of the digital age.

passages.passageText: The fast fashion industry is known for producing large quantities of clothes at a very low cost. These garments are designed to be trendy and are sold in shops shortly after they appear on the fashion runway. While this allows consumers to buy stylish clothes for little money, it has a negative impact on the planet. The production process uses a lot of water and chemicals, which can pollute the environment. Moreover, since the clothes are cheap, many people wear them only a few times before they throw them away. This leads to a massive amount of waste in landfills. To address this problem, some people are choosing to buy second-hand clothes or support brands that focus on sustainability. Sustainable fashion promotes the idea of buying fewer items of higher quality. By making better choices, shoppers can help to reduce the damage that the fashion industry causes to the world. It is a slow but necessary change for the future.

passages.passageText: The popularity of electric vehicles is increasing as people become more concerned about the environment. Unlike traditional cars that use gasoline, electric vehicles run on electricity. This means they do not produce harmful gases that pollute the air of the city. One major benefit is that they are much quieter than engines that use petrol. However, there are still some obstacles that prevent everyone from buying one. For instance, the price of an electric car is often higher than the price of a regular car. Also, the battery of the car needs to be charged regularly. In some places, it is difficult to find a charging station. Despite these problems, technology is improving. Batteries can now last longer, and many governments are providing money to help people buy electric cars. As more charging stations are built, the transition to green transport will become easier for the general public.

passages.passageText: Coffee is more than just a drink; it is a vital part of the culture in many countries. Each region has its own unique way to prepare and enjoy this popular beverage. In Italy, people often stand at a bar to drink a quick espresso before they go to work. In contrast, coffee in Turkey is served in small cups and is known for being very strong and thick. It is often a social event where friends sit and talk for hours. Meanwhile, in Ethiopia, the birthplace of coffee, there is a traditional coffee ceremony that can take a long time. It involves roasting the beans and serving the drink to guests with respect. These traditions show that coffee is a way to bring people together. Whether it is a fast morning routine or a long social gathering, coffee plays an important role in the daily life of millions.

passages.passageText: The gig economy refers to a labor market that consists of short term contracts or freelance work. Instead of working for one employer for a long time, individuals do small jobs, or gigs, for different clients. Technology has made this possible through apps that connect workers with people who need services. For example, a person can drive a car for a ride sharing company or deliver food in the evening. This way of working offers a lot of flexibility. Workers can choose when they want to start and stop. However, there are some negative aspects. Freelancers do not usually receive benefits such as health insurance or paid holidays. Their income can also be very unpredictable from one month to the next. Some people enjoy the freedom of the gig economy, while others prefer the security of a traditional full time position. As the world of work continues to evolve, the gig economy will likely remain a significant part of the global market.

passages.passageText: Sleep is a necessary function that allows the body and the mind to recharge. Without enough sleep, the brain cannot function properly. This can affect the ability to concentrate, think clearly, and process memories. Most adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep each night. However, many people struggle to get enough rest because of busy schedules or stress. Scientists have found that the blue light from electronic devices, such as phones and tablets, can interfere with the quality of sleep. It is recommended to avoid screens at least one hour before bed. Another tip for better sleep is to keep a consistent schedule by going to sleep and waking up at the same time every day. Good sleep habits are essential for long term health and can improve the mood and the productivity of a person during the day. Taking care of the rest of the body is just as important as diet and exercise.

passages.passageText: Volunteering is a powerful way to give back to the community and help those in need. Many people choose to spend their free time working at local charities, animal shelters, or schools. While the main goal is to help others, volunteering also provides many benefits for the volunteer. For instance, it is a great way to learn new skills that can be useful in a professional career. It also allows individuals to meet new people and expand the social network. Furthermore, studies have shown that volunteering can improve mental health by reducing stress and providing a sense of purpose. It makes people feel good to know they are making a difference in the world. Whether it is a few hours a week or a longer commitment, the impact of volunteering is significant for both the community and the individual who gives the time.

passages.passageText: Street food markets have become a popular destination for tourists and locals alike. However, some people are concerned about the hygiene of the stalls. It is important to choose vendors who appear clean and follow basic safety rules. In many cities, street food is a reflection of the culture and the history of the place. Visiting a market is not just about the food; it is an experience for all the senses. The sights, smells, and sounds of a busy market create a vibrant atmosphere that is hard to forget.

passages.passageText: Learning a second language is a challenging but rewarding journey. It opens up a world of opportunities for travel, work, and personal growth. When a person learns a new language, they also learn about the culture and the history of the people who speak it. This can lead to a greater understanding and empathy for different perspectives. Many experts agree that the best way to learn is through immersion. This involves practicing the language every day by listening to music, watching movies, or speaking with native speakers. While it can be frustrating to make mistakes, they are a natural part of the learning process. In fact, making errors is often how students improve. With patience and persistence, anyone can achieve a high level of fluency. In an increasingly globalized world, the ability to communicate in more than one language is a valuable asset that can enhance the life of a person in many ways.

passages.passageText: Minimalism is a lifestyle choice that focuses on living with fewer possessions. The main idea is to remove the clutter from the life of a person so they can focus on what is truly important. Many people find that owning too many things causes stress and anxiety. By getting rid of items they do not use, they feel more free and organized. Minimalism is not just about the physical space; it is also about how people spend their time and money. Instead of buying new products, minimalists often invest in experiences, such as travel or learning a new hobby. This approach helps people to appreciate what they already have. However, starting a minimalist journey can be difficult. It requires a lot of discipline to stop buying things that are not necessary. In the end, many find that a simpler life leads to greater happiness and a more meaningful existence.

passages.passageText: The sharing economy is a socio-economic system built around the sharing of resources. It often involves a platform that connects individuals who have something with those who need it. Common examples include renting a room in the home of someone else or borrowing a car for a short trip. This system allows people to save money and use assets more efficiently. It also has environmental benefits because it reduces the need for everyone to own every item. For example, if ten people share one car, fewer cars are manufactured. However, the sharing economy also faces criticism. Some argue that it creates unfair competition for traditional businesses like hotels or taxi companies. There are also concerns about the safety and the privacy of the users. Despite these issues, the sharing economy continues to grow because of the convenience it offers. It represents a major shift in how modern society thinks about ownership and community resources.

options.text: The sharing of resources.

passages.passageText: In the modern world, digital literacy is a fundamental skill for everyone. It refers to the ability to find, evaluate, and communicate information using various digital platforms. This includes knowing how to use the internet safely and how to identify fake news. As more services move online, people who lack these skills may find it difficult to apply for a job or access healthcare. Schools are now including digital literacy in the curriculum to prepare students for the future. However, it is not just for young people; older adults also benefit from learning how to use technology to stay connected with the family. Furthermore, understanding privacy settings is crucial to protect the personal data of the individual. By improving digital skills, people can navigate the digital landscape with confidence and participate fully in the social and the economic life of the community.

passages.passageText: Food waste is a major problem that affects the economy and the environment. Every year, a huge amount of food is thrown away by households and businesses. This happens for various reasons, such as overbuying or not understanding the dates on the labels. When food is wasted, all the resources used to produce it, like water and energy, are also wasted. Furthermore, food in landfills produces methane, a gas that contributes to climate change. To be more sustainable, people can take simple steps at home. For instance, they can plan the meals for the week and only buy what they need. Composting is another excellent way to turn food scraps into useful soil for the garden. By being more mindful of the way they consume food, individuals can help to protect the planet and save money. Small changes in the daily routine can lead to a big difference in the future health of the world.

passages.passageText: Working from cafes has become a popular choice for freelancers and remote workers. These spaces offer a change of scenery and a lively atmosphere that many people find inspiring. The smell of coffee and the sound of low conversation can help some individuals to focus better than they do in a quiet office. Most cafes now provide free internet and plenty of power outlets to attract customers who want to work. However, there are some unspoken rules that one should follow. It is polite to buy a drink or a snack every few hours to support the business. Also, it is important to be mindful of the noise level, especially when taking a phone call. While a cafe is a great place for creativity, it can sometimes be distracting if it is too busy. Despite the potential for noise, the trend of using cafes as offices continues to grow in cities all over the world.
